title: Verb forms
about: The everyday verbs are the irregular ones: *τρώω → έφαγα, θα φάω*; *βλέπω → είδα, θα δω*; *λέω → είπα, θα πω*; *πίνω → ήπια, θα πιω*; *έρχομαι → ήρθα, θα έρθω*. The augment *ε-* appears only when it carries the stress (*έγραψα*, but *γράψαμε*). Learned compounds put the augment inside (*επέστρεψα*), and verbs in *-ομαι* have their own imperatives (*ντύσου*, *κάθισε*).

items.en: Yesterday I ate moussaka at the taverna.

errs.why: *τρώω* has the irregular aorist *έφαγα* (*θα φάω*, *να φάω*).

items.en: I'll see Maria in the afternoon.

errs.why: The perfective of *βλέπω* is *δ-*: *θα δω*, *να δεις*; aorist *είδα*.

items.en: Tell me what you want.

errs.why: The imperative of *λέω* is *πες* (plural *πείτε*): *πες μου*.

items.en: Eat your food, it's getting cold!

errs.why: The imperative of *τρώω* is *φάε* (plural *φάτε*).

items.en: I'll come at eight.

errs.why: *έρχομαι* has the perfective *έρθ-* (formal *έλθω*): *θα έρθω*, *να έρθεις*; aorist *ήρθα*. There is no active *έρχω*.

items.en: In the summer I went to Santorini.

errs.why: *πηγαίνω/πάω* has the aorist *πήγα*.

parts: Ήπια έναν καφέ και είδα τις ειδήσεις.
items.en: I had a coffee and watched the news.
Last night we went out with colleagues.

errs.why: *βγαίνω* has the aorist *βγήκα*, with no augment: *βγήκαμε*.

items.en: Yesterday we had a maths test.

errs.why: The augment *ε-* appears only when it is stressed: *έγραψα*, *έγραψες*, but *γράψαμε*, *γράψατε*.

items.en: I'm afraid of big dogs.

errs.why: "I'm afraid" is the deponent *φοβάμαι*. Active *φοβίζω* means "I frighten someone".

items.en: Get dressed quickly, we'll be late!

errs.why: *ντύνομαι* "get dressed" has the imperative *ντύσου* (plural *ντυθείτε*). *Ντύσε* means "dress someone": *ντύσε το μωρό*.

items.en: Children, close your books.

errs.why: The plural imperative is *κλείστε*, *γράψτε*, *ανοίξτε*. *Κλείσετε* is the subjunctive (*να κλείσετε*).

items.en: My brother drives very carefully.

errs.why: *οδηγώ* belongs to the *-είς/-εί* group: *οδηγώ, οδηγείς, οδηγεί*, like *μπορώ* and *ζω*. Only verbs like *αγαπάω* have *-άει*.

items.en: Yesterday I went to sleep very late.

errs.why: *κοιμάμαι* has the aorist *κοιμήθηκα*.

parts: Γεννήθηκα στη Θεσσαλονίκη, αλλά μεγάλωσα στην Αθήνα.
items.en: I was born in Thessaloniki but grew up in Athens.
The door was covered in graffiti.

errs.why: The passive participle of *γράφω* is *γραμμένος*, with double *μ*.

items.en: What happened? Why are you shouting?

errs.why: *συμβαίνει* has the learned aorist *συνέβη*, plural *συνέβησαν*.

parts: από τις διακοπές, το σπίτι ήταν άνω κάτω.
items.en: When we got back from holiday, the house was upside down.

errs.why: Learned compounds keep the inner augment only when it is stressed: *επέστρεψα*, *επέστρεψες*, but *επιστρέψαμε*, *επιστρέψατε*.

items.en: Our proposal was approved by the management.

errs.why: *εγκρίνω* has the passive aorist *εγκρίθηκε*, like *κρίνω → κρίθηκε*.

items.en: When the director came in, everyone stood up.

errs.why: In the 3rd person plural the passive aorist keeps the stress on the third-last syllable: *σηκώθηκαν*, *χάθηκαν*. Only the 1st and 2nd plural move it: *σηκωθήκαμε*.

parts: Ο πρόεδρος ανέλαβε τα καθήκοντά του τον Μάρτιο.
items.en: The president took up his duties in March.
items.why: Nothing to fix: *αναλαμβάνω* has the aorist *ανέλαβα* with an inner augment, and *καθήκοντα* takes a second accent before *του*.

items.en: The municipality submitted a funding application.

errs.why: *υποβάλλω* is a learned compound: the augment goes inside and carries the stress, *υπέβαλα*, *υπέβαλε*; but *υποβάλαμε*.

items.en: The police arrested two suspects.

errs.why: *συλλαμβάνω* has the aorist *συνέλαβα* (inner augment, *λ* becomes *ν* before the vowel); plural *συλλάβαμε*, *συνέλαβαν*.

items.en: The book was translated into twenty languages.

errs.why: Passive aorist ending *-ηκε*: *μεταφράστηκε*.

items.en: The government issued a statement.

errs.why: *εκδίδω* has the aorist *εξέδωσα* with *ω*, like *δίνω → έδωσα*.

items.en: The ministers resigned after the scandal.

errs.why: *παραιτούμαι* has the aorist *παραιτήθηκα*, 3rd plural *παραιτήθηκαν*.

items.en: The conference will be held in Thessaloniki.

errs.why: Passive perfective forms end in *-εί*: *θα διεξαχθεί*, *να ληφθεί*, *να εγκριθεί*. The *-ή* ending is the old spelling.

parts: Τα μέτρα που ελήφθησαν δεν απέδωσαν τα αναμενόμενα.
items.en: The measures taken did not deliver the expected results.
items.why: Nothing to fix: *ελήφθησαν* is the learned passive aorist of *λαμβάνω* (everyday *πάρθηκαν*), and *απέδωσαν* keeps the inner augment of *αποδίδω*.
